entries.title: Psalms 140:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> Deliver me, O LORD, from evil men; Preserve me from violent men,

entries.title: Psalms 140:2
segments: Who plan evil things in [their] hearts; They continually gather together [for] war.

entries.title: Psalms 140:3
segments: They sharpen their tongues like a serpent; The poison of asps [is] under their lips. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 140:4
segments: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; Preserve me from violent men, Who have purposed to make my steps stumble.

entries.title: Psalms 140:5
segments: The proud have hidden a snare for me, and cords; They have spread a net by the wayside; They have set traps for me. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 140:6
segments: I said to the LORD: "You [are] my God; Hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 140:7
segments: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You have covered my head in the day of battle.

entries.title: Psalms 140:8
segments: ¶Do not grant, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; Do not further his [wicked] scheme, [Lest] they be exalted. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 140:9
segments: "[As for] the head of those who surround me, Let the evil of their lips cover them;

entries.title: Psalms 140:10
segments: Let burning coals fall upon them; Let them be cast into the fire, Into deep pits, that they rise not up again.

entries.title: Psalms 140:11
segments: Let not a slanderer be established in the earth; Let evil hunt the violent man to overthrow [him]."

entries.title: Psalms 140:12
segments: I know that the LORD will maintain The cause of the afflicted, [And] justice for the poor.

entries.title: Psalms 140:13
segments: Surely the righteous shall give thanks to Your name; The upright shall dwell in Your presence.
